definitions.explanation: having a sharp incline; difficult to climb or traverse
forbidding or threatening in appearance or manner

examples.japanese: {険|けわ}しい⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧。
examples.english: To climb a steep mountain path.

⟦{頂上|ちょうじょう}→頂上：03493_choujou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{険|けわ}しく⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。

notes:
SENSE 1 - STEEP:
- Used for terrain, paths, mountains, cliffs
- {険|けわ}しい⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧ (steep mountain)
- {険|けわ}しい⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ (steep path)

SENSE 2 - HARSH/STERN:
- Used for facial expressions, situations
- {険|けわ}しい⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧ (stern expression)
- {険|けわ}しい⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (harsh face)
- {先行|せんこう}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{険|けわ}しい (the outlook is grim)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧ (steep, sudden)
- ⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧ (strict, severe)

WRITING:
{険|けん}しい uses the same kanji as ⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧ (danger), reflecting the challenging nature of steep terrain.
